script:
# TC-002: Neutralisation heat is limited by the smaller reagent budget
# Design only: predictions below are not measured observations.
register lv3
add v1 water 50mL
add v1 HCl 0.001mol
new
add v2 water 50mL
add v2 HCl 0.002mol
new
add v3 water 50mL
add v3 NaOH 0.0005mol
new
add v4 water 50mL
add v4 NaOH 0.0005mol
measure v1 thermometer
measure v2 thermometer
measure v3 thermometer
measure v4 thermometer
decant v3 v1 1
decant v4 v2 1
measure v1 thermometer
measure v2 thermometer
measure v1 calorimeter
measure v2 calorimeter
measure v1 ph
measure v2 ph
inspect
